Name: Pet While Sleeping
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Pet While Sleeping[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Pet While Sleeping lets you pet your farm animals after 20:00 if you forgot to until then so you don't miss the chance to gain friendship.
I've made this mod because I forgot one too many times to pet my ducks and only remembered at night.
Worked well in my testing but it was quite limited so any feedback/issues that you can report are appreciated. I'll do my best to solve them.


[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Allows petting of farm animals after 20:00[/*]
[*]Allows gaining friendship points when farm animals are sleeping[/*]
[*]Allows setting a penalty to friendship when petting at night[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] -> optional but recommended[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Adjust settings via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu in-game.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[line]
✅ Built for Stardew Valley 1.6+
✅ Multiplayer compatible
✅ SDV
✅ RSV
✅ ES
❌ N/A
